description: Run PwrAgent's unit tests, lint, typecheck, and Linux desktop E2E in a Sandboxer cloud sandbox instead of on the local machine. Use when the thread has the Sandboxer MCP (create_sandbox and exec tools) and a change needs `pnpm test`, `pnpm lint`, `pnpm typecheck`, or `pnpm test:desktop-e2e`. Sandboxer is Ubuntu only: it does not verify macOS or Windows behavior.
